_meanings:
.²1 Reverential salutation, respectful obeisance, salutation of a superior
 or elder by an inferior or junior, or of a teacher by his disciple. It
 consists in (1) rising from oneʼs seat ({#pratyutTAna#}); (2) clasping
 the feet ({#pAdopasaMgraha#}), and (3) repeating the form of salutation
 ({#aBivAda#}) which includes the name or title of the person addressed,
 followed by the mention of the personʼs own name. For the different ways
 of performing obeisance and the merit arising therefrom see <ls>Ms. 2. 120-126</ls>.
